subject: a tall stack of three thick, fluffy buttermilk pancakes topped with a dollop of whipped cream, a generous scatter of whole fresh blueberries and a spoonful of chunky blueberry compote running down one side
hero_ko: 통 블루베리 + 생크림 + 과육 씹히는 블루베리 콩포트

geometry.silhouette: 3단 두툼 스택(약 2.5cm/장), 돔 윗면, 부푼 둥근 가장자리, 손으로 놓은 오프셋, 높이≈폭의 60%, 프레임 폭 65% 점유. 토핑은 전부 윗면에 얹힘(반죽에 박지 않음).
geometry.body: Three thick, tender pancakes stacked with a small, casual offset, as if placed by hand rather than aligned by a machine — the middle one shifted a little to the right, the top one a little back. Each pancake is a plump, pillowy round about 2.5 cm thick with a gently domed top and a soft rounded edge that bulges slightly outward where the batter rose in the pan; the stack is about 60% as tall as it is wide and occupies roughly 65% of the frame width, leaving generous empty background around it. The top face of each pancake is griddle-browned in a soft, blotchy, uneven gradient — warm caramel brown (#B9793F) at the centre where it sat longest on the hot pan, fading through toasty golden (#CF9455) into light golden (#D9A76B) toward the rim, with a few slightly darker freckles and one paler patch where a bubble lifted the batter, the way real pancakes never brown evenly. The side wall of every pancake is the pale cream of the risen crumb (#F1DDB0): a soft, spongy band with a fine open crumb texture, tiny irregular air pockets catching the light, meeting the browned top in a soft blurred edge rather than a hard line. A few tiny pinprick pores sit near the rim of the top pancake, barely visible. Where the pancakes touch, the top one presses very slightly into the one below, so the edges kiss softly instead of floating. The whole stack looks warm, tender and freshly flipped — the honest irregularity of a handmade bake.

toppings.label: WHIPPED CREAM
toppings.text: One generous dollop of lightly whipped cream (#FFF8EC), spoon-dropped rather than piped, sits slightly off-centre toward the front-left of the top pancake: soft rounded peaks with gentle folds and one curl on top, a matte velvety surface with a faint ivory warmth, slumping a little under the fruit and relaxing at its lower edge into a soft skirt where the warm pancake and the compote touch it.

toppings.label: BLUEBERRIES
toppings.text: About fifteen whole fresh blueberries, never cut — deep indigo-violet (#3B4470) under a soft dusty grey-blue bloom (#7E8BB5) that rubs off where they touch, each with its tiny five-pointed crown on top and each a slightly different size, from small firm ones to a few plump ones almost twice the size — piled in a loose, uneven heap: six or seven sitting on and against the cream, the rest tumbling down its side across the browned top pancake, two rolled to the rim, one caught in a compote drip on the side wall. A couple have split slightly and show a glimpse of pale green-white flesh; no two sit at the same angle.

toppings.label: COMPOTE
toppings.text: A spoonful of warm blueberry compote — not a smooth syrup but a thick, glossy, deep purple (#4A1E4F) sauce with crushed berry skins and a few whole soft berries in it — spooned over the heap so it pools between the berries, stains the cream where it touches in soft violet streaks, and runs over the front edge of the top pancake in three uneven drips of different lengths and widths down the pale side walls: one thick drip reaching the bottom pancake and rounding into a heavy bead, one thinner drip stopping on the middle layer, one just beginning. Where it runs it turns the crumb a darker soaked purple and catches a bright soft highlight.

toppings.label: FINISHING
toppings.text: A barely-there haze of powdered sugar dusted over the berries and the far rim of the top pancake, catching on the bloom of the berries as tiny pale specks. One small sprig of fresh mint with two crisp leaves (#3E7A45) tucked into the cream. The toppings gather toward the front-left so the browned pancake surface stays visible on the opposite side, and the composition reads as one deliberate, appetizing arrangement — realistic portion size, no duplicate identical elements.

materials_lighting: Premium food-icon look: slightly simplified, clean forms with believable, appetizing materials — matte tender pancake crumb with a faint velvety sheen only where it browned, soft-matte cream, bloom-dusted blueberries with a soft matte skin and glossy split flesh, a thick glossy compote with visible crushed fruit, waxy mint leaves. Soft studio softbox key light from the upper left with gentle warm ambient fill, a subtle rim of light along the top edges of the stack, and a faint, soft contact shadow directly beneath the stack only. Appetizing food-photography color grading: warm, fresh, clean whites, saturated but natural colours, no colour cast on the background. Shot as if with an 85 mm lens at a comfortable distance, everything in crisp focus.
camera: Three-quarter top-front view, the dessert centered with generous margin on all sides.
background: Background: seamless solid pale sage (#DFEAE0), flat and even.

notes_ko: v5(2026-09-02): 리서치(med) — 블루베리는 통째(자르지 않음), 소스는 매끈한 시럽이 아니라 으깬 과육이 씹히는 진한 자주색 콩포트, 생크림 돌롭 + 슈가파우더 + 민트. 한국 카페 세트의 캐러멜 바나나는 주재료 식별성 위해 제외. 과분(블룸) 서술로 점토 구슬 회피.
